title: Qualify and revalidate Orabona convex optimality and interior consequence
head: codex/research-online-optimality-migration
body:
The optimality reader conflated Orabona Theorem 2.8, its two library helpers and the mandatory following interior-gradient-zero consequence. This package revalidates four retained proofs and qualifies the existing reader with distinct semantic actors. All frozen statement hashes, proof tokens and canary bytes remain unchanged; no new proofs or registry nodes are claimed.

The source criterion retains an arbitrary open neighborhood, both finite-value conditions, differentiability of the canonical real representative and feasible membership. The implementation weakens neighborhood convexity to ConvexOn V, giving a stronger theorem, rather than an equivalent premise set. The interior consequence requires ambient interior and the retained genuine derivative; it does not assert zero gradient at boundary minimizers. The real criterion and finite-order bridge are explicitly classified as library refinements with their own assumptions.

Validation: fresh shared root (9088 jobs), Tests (9230 jobs), complete harness (466 tests, 7 existing skips), 13 named axiom audits, 4 native guards, byte-identical nondegenerate boundary/interior canary, exact stacked contributor gate (4 production paths/1 manifest), scoped whitespace, clean lean-verified site/check and all 10806 old IDs/URLs retained. The actual compiled graph export is scoped to 4 nodes/510 direct type/value edges, not a full/canary graph. Distinct contract/body/final reader decisions and exact historical snapshot bindings are recorded.

Stacked dependency: OPEN draft #158 at c9b47c8ba79a234d0dfa6e8ef5643a43677dd33a; this is not accepted on main. The main-relative contributor diagnostic reports 14 other legacy module contracts missing. Full whitespace diagnostic fails on exact raw logs; scoped checking preserves enumerated raw bytes while checking code/JSON/scripts/docs. Chapter 2 has an incomplete/null mandatory total and the Chapters 1–16 Goal remains active; legacy semantic migrations decrease only 18→17. No merge or deployment.

Evidence: runs/online-optimality-migration-20261005/accepted-decision-v1.json, accepted-binding-audit-v1.json, native-acceptance-overlay-v1.json, final-reader-receipt-v1.json and integrated-gates-overlay-v1.json; frozen source/native targets in docs/contracts/online-optimality-migration-v1. Site source commit 04b7a8d7eba28f7c9e43cf410b55b6611efadab7 is distinct from later evidence/delivery commits.
